0.original: Yubli wishes to replenish the travel agency's supply of fiend repellent.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Use the extractors to harvest nectar from fragrant flowers near Xodune.

25.original: Deliver the fragrant nectar to Yubli.

48.original: As part of our ongoing efforts to ward off fiends from the area, we've been using a powerful incense. Stocks have dwindled, however, and we'll soon need to craft a new batch.

49.original: Unfortunately, we don't have the necessary ingredients to hand. We create the incense using the nectar of a particularly fragrant flower. The only trouble is it grows in a somewhat perilous location─there aren't many we can ask to brave the trip.

50.original: But I don't imagine our special advisor will have much trouble! Here, take these extractors. Using them, you should be able to harvest the nectar without harming the foliage. Head for Xodune─the plant is known to bloom in the surrounding area.

51.original: Welcome back. Were you able to harvest sufficient nectar?

52.original: I recognize that scent! Excellent work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

53.original: It was the Hanuhanu who shared the repellent recipe with us. Apparently, it's especially effective at warding off fiends native to Kozama'uka.

54.original: Thanks to that powerful scent, fiend encounters are down, and customer satisfaction is up! It's also alleviated some of the burden placed on our guides-turned-protectors. Anyway, we soon get through the stuff, so I'll let you know the next time our stocks need replenishing!
